events.text: Five sets entered four-day TEE service pool, which ran until 1964.

evidence.quote: From 2 June 1957 to 30 May 1964 the five sets were used in a four-day service pool

events.text: L'Oiseau Bleu service went permanently to loco-hauled Inox coaches.

evidence.quote: From 31 May 1964 , the LOiseau Bleu went to permanently locomotive-hauled Inox coaches

events.text: L'Etoile du Nord also went loco-hauled; pool became a three-day circuit.

evidence.quote: From 2 August 1964 LÉtoile du Nord also went loco-hauled

events.text: L'Arbalete service became loco-hauled Inox coaches; filling-in turn changed.

evidence.quote: This lasted until 28 September 1969 , LArbalète became locomotive-hauled Inox coaches

events.text: Three-day pool ended after one trainset was written off; four sets kept for Edelweiss.

evidence.quote: This three-day pool lasted until one trainset was written off in an accident in February 1971

events.text: Last day of the sets in TEE service.

evidence.quote: until 24 May 1974 which was their last day in TEE service

events.text: TEE discontinued diesel trainsets on all its services.

evidence.quote: As from 26 May 1974 , TEE discontinued the use of diesel trainsets on all its services

events.text: All four remaining sets sold to Ontario Northland Railway, Canada.

evidence.quote: In 1977 , all four were sold to the Ontario Northland Railway ( ONT ) of Canada

events.label: rebuild
events.text: Power cars replaced with standard EMD FP7 diesel locomotives (first year).

evidence.quote: In 1979 and 1980 , the power cars were replaced with standard EMD FP7 diesel locomotives

events.label: rebuild
events.text: Power cars replaced with standard EMD FP7 diesel locomotives (second year).

evidence.quote: In 1979 and 1980 , the power cars were replaced with standard EMD FP7 diesel locomotives

events.text: Northlander trains in Ontario Northland service ended.

evidence.quote: The trains continued in service until February 1992

events.text: TEE Netherlands Foundation gathered all five cars at Zwolle for restoration.

evidence.quote: In June 2006 the TEE Netherlands Foundation brought all five cars together at Zwolle for restoration

events.text: Trainset placed at Dijksgracht yard in Amsterdam, waiting for repair.

evidence.quote: The trainset has been on the railway yard Dijksgracht in Amsterdam since 2007

events.text: Ownership of the coaches transferred from the TEE foundation.

evidence.quote: Ownership of the coaches was transferred on January 5 , 2021
